name: OpenClaw
description: OpenClaw is a self-hosted AI assistant gateway that can integrate with messaging platforms and local LLM providers.

notes.text: After installation, enter the container and run 'openclaw onboard' to configure a provider.
Security default: the gateway binds to loopback. For remote access, use SSH port forwarding: ssh -L 18789:localhost:18789 root@<CT-IP> then open http://localhost:18789
The Control UI requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost). Use a reverse proxy with HTTPS if exposing beyond localhost.
